newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Peters says would name Moore trade minister.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Peters says would name Moore trade minister.

text.p: New Zealand First leader Winston Peters on Wednesday named Labour MP Mike Moore as a future NZ First cabinet minister in a NZ First "Ministry of Talent", the New Zealand Press Association reported.

Peters, in a prepared speech to a lunchtime audience in Te Kuiti, said if the former Labour leader were elected to Parliament he would be appointed by NZ First as minister of trade negotiations and overseas trade.

Peters said the appointment would be part of the NZ First "Ministry of Talent" policy already announced, which would see the party appoint MPs to cabinet from outside the party, and possibly from outside the ranks of any coalition partner.
Moore is a close ally of NZ First strategist and former MP Michael Laws, who was last week accused of taking over the party by two candidates who resigned.

Earlier this year there were suggestions of a Mike Moore party taking in Laws, former Labour MP Jack Elder (now NZ First) and another defector to NZ First, former National MP Pete McCardle, but that party never eventuated.
